_comment: Known-red baseline for the ui vitest project. A test listed here may fail without blocking a deploy; anything NOT listed blocks it. Regenerate with `node scripts/test-ui-gate.mjs --write-baseline` after deliberately accepting a failure. Source of the first baseline: /tmp/ship-p0.log, a full `vitest run --project ui` on 2026-10-30 (12,582 tests, 61 failing assertions across 32 files; 1 file fails at suite load and carries no assertion names).
tests: src/app/chat/close-tab.test.ts > closeActiveTab > leaves ⌘W to the zone rungs even with previews open
src/app/chat/close-tab.test.ts > closeWorkspaceTab > a focused tool panel (terminal / logs) claims ⌘W before main empties
src/app/chat/close-tab.test.ts > closeWorkspaceTab > drops a lone loaded main to a fresh draft
src/app/chat/close-tab.test.ts > closeWorkspaceTab > shifts the next stacked session into main
src/app/chat/close-tab.test.ts > closeWorkspaceTab > ⌘W reaches it once the terminal and zone tabs pass
src/app/chat/sidebar/chat-sidebar.integration.test.tsx > ChatSidebar empty-profile sections > shows a section per profile when several profiles have no chats anywhere
src/app/chat/sidebar/chat-sidebar.integration.test.tsx > ChatSidebar empty-profile sections > shows the messaging section for a profile with no normal sessions
src/app/chat/sidebar/chat-sidebar.integration.test.tsx > ChatSidebar navigation activity > keeps navigation and session activity coherent with the focused pane
src/app/chat/sidebar/chat-sidebar.integration.test.tsx > ChatSidebar section labels > keeps the "Sessions" label when grouping is on but no projects exist
src/app/chat/sidebar/chat-sidebar.integration.test.tsx > ChatSidebar section labels > keeps the "Sessions" label when the grouped tree is only the synthetic Home bucket
src/app/gateway/hooks/primary-reauth-notice.test.ts > offers Gateways settings to a parked background primary, whatever the error
src/app/shell/titlebar-controls.test.tsx > titlebar app-action cluster > hides a review-only right sidebar instead of opening files
src/app/shell/titlebar-controls.test.tsx > titlebar app-action cluster > names and toggles the sides from docked state in a narrow native window, as on main

src/components/pane-shell/tree/side-collapse-persistence.test.ts > side visibility survives a page refresh independently of Files > restores the last presentation without revealing hidden, minimized or inactive panes
src/sdk/settings.test.ts > host.settings > preserves the stores existing persistence schema
src/store/panes.test.ts > panes store > width overrides > open flag is persisted across changes
src/store/panes.test.ts > panes store > width overrides > width override is NOT in-memory only, and is persisted across reloads
